title: Farm Golding
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Discover

Quest Description: Head to Ratsputin's Gulag and find the farms on the folowing levels:

  • Rasputin's Gulag 1
  • Rasputin's Gulag 1 Subdungeon
  • Rasputin's Gulag 2
  • Rasputin's Gulag 3
  • Rasputin's Gulag 3 Subdungeon
  • Rasputin's Gulag 4
  • Rasputin's Gulag 4 Subdungeon


Quest Reward: 9375 Gold

Return to: Yakov Smearnov in Rasputin's Holding Cell

Repeatable: No

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Investigate the reports of Farm Golding in the Upper levels of Ratsputin's Gulag and report to the Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

There is some flaming hot news coming out of Ratsputin's Gulag and it has all of the Dungeon Runners up in arms. It appears that someone, or something, or perhaps something's someone, Gosh, it could even be someone's something, is turning the farms inside the dungeon into gold! But that is not the bad thing, because let's face it, that is kind of cool. The problem is that they are then farming the gold vegetables and selling them to Dungeon Runners. These Dungeon Runners, usually ones that are low in level as well as motivation, pay for the gold with some other mystery currency, which I can only assume is marbles. This is really making the hard working, no life having, Dungeon Runner quite upset, and with good reason if you ask me!

Look, I need your eyes on this situation right now. I need you to check on all of the farms in the upper dungeon. Each level has a farm and they are all reported to have been turned into gold, or what some Dungeon Runners are calling being golded. When you have checked all of the farms report to Yakov Smearnov in Ratsputin's Holding Cell. He is a nice guy and he used to be funny...a *long* time ago.

Turn-in:

How is he doing it, Dungeon Runner? I suspect that Ratsputin is behind this. We must find out more....

Objectives:

  • Locate the Farm on Level 1
  • Locate the Farm on Level 1 Branch
  • Locate the Farm on Level 2
  • Locate the Farm on Level 3
  • Locate the Farm on Level 3 Branch
  • Locate the Farm on Level 4
  • Locate the Farm on Level 4 Branch

Client level range: 75–100
